deliverables: Milestone-based disbursement controls through TRSC/PSSC smart contracts
request.recipient: 2026 Treasury Reserve Smart Contract stake address stake1784sdxt6jjennmstphgdu7l7c2scf5d02a6cve2dgn5s2kq5u3j9v, with Intersect administering funds for the vendor/project
request.what: Treasury withdrawal to fund Mithril Protocol continuous development through Intersect's budget process

claims.claim: Mithril uses stake-based threshold multi-signatures to certify Cardano state in a trustless way so nodes and applications can verify state rapidly without relying on the entire chain.

The proposal states that full node synchronization is slow and light clients currently rely on centralized trust, making secure access to verified blockchain state a pressing infrastructure challenge.

Funding Mithril's continued development through Intersect is presented as a way for Cardano to scale while preserving decentralization guarantees and avoiding dependency on centralized indexers and hosted APIs.

The proposal achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase and was advanced for on-chain Treasury Withdrawal submission under the approved Budget Process Framework.
The requested 3,810,423 ada is allocated as 3,699,440 ada for Mithril Protocol Continuous Development and 110,983 ada for the Intersect Budget Administration fee.
The proposer states that the withdrawal did not, at submission, breach the 350M Net Change Limit for Epoch 613 to Epoch 713, either alone or in aggregate.

Audit, administrative oversight, reporting obligations, and milestone-based disbursement controls are included through Intersect overhead, Intersect administration, and technically capable third-party oversight.
Teragone has not previously received direct Cardano treasury or community governance funding, but has worked on Mithril for several years through IOG-funded collaboration.

Intersect will use Sundae Labs treasury management smart contracts with specified TRSC and PSSC addresses, role-based authorization thresholds, and an oversight committee of six named external entities.
A public dashboard and on-chain records are presented as mechanisms for the community to audit and track the withdrawn ada.

summary: The document requests 3,810,423 ada for Mithril Protocol continuous development, administered by Intersect through treasury management smart contracts with budget-process, NCL, oversight, and dashboard references.
